articles.title: Luxury litigation, poor pay the price
articles.description: The Supreme Court has issued a warning against what it terms 'luxury litigation', leading to the dismissal of a persistent case. Wealthy individuals may bear the financial strain, while those less fortunate face ongoing challenges. Effective case management and expedited judicial appointments are essential for improvement.

articles.title: In 1959, Auckland opened its Harbour Bridge after 3 years of construction. 10 years later, clip-on sections doubled its capacity from 4 lanes to 8 lanes for city traffic
articles.description: Auckland Harbour Bridge's initial construction prioritized affordability over immediate full capacity. The bridge was later expanded with clip-on lanes to meet growing traffic demands. This staged approach allowed the city to finance infrastructure as its economy grew. The expansion doubled the bridge's traffic capacity at a relatively lower cost. This strategy enabled Auckland to develop its harbour crossing over time.
